settings.label: Cycle
settings.title: Hair growth cycle
settings.text: Hair moves through anagen (growth), catagen (transition) and telogen (rest/shed). A full visible shift often takes around 90 days of consistent care — which is why JustNatur is built as a 90-day ritual, not a weekend fix.

settings.label: Follicles
settings.title: Hair follicles need fuel
settings.text: Follicles are metabolically active mini-organs. When nutrition, sleep or stress dips, shedding and thinning often follow. External oils can condition strands — they cannot replace internal fuel.

settings.label: Iron
settings.title: Iron & hair
settings.text: Low iron stores are commonly linked with increased shedding. Food-based sources and seed nutrition are part of how Kesha Mula supports daily micronutrient intake.

settings.label: Zinc
settings.title: Zinc & protein
settings.text: Zinc and adequate protein support keratin production and follicle function. Pumpkin seeds, sesame and related botanicals contribute naturally occurring minerals and amino acids.

settings.label: Stress
settings.title: Stress & sleep
settings.text: Chronic stress can push more follicles into the shedding phase. Sleep quality compounds the effect. Adaptogenic herbs like Ashwagandha are included to support the body's stress response as part of overall wellness.

settings.label: Hormones
settings.title: Hormones & postpartum
settings.text: Hormonal shifts — including postpartum — frequently show up in hair density. JustNatur does not claim to treat medical conditions; we focus on nutritional support while you work with your clinician when needed.

settings.label: Scalp
settings.title: Scalp environment
settings.text: A healthy scalp supports strand quality. Kesha Amrith Hair Oil is designed for massage, nourishment, shine and softness — the outside half of the inside-out system.

settings.label: Ayurveda
settings.title: How Ayurveda supports hair
settings.text: Classics like Amla, Bhringraj, Fenugreek and Curry leaf have long traditional associations with hair vitality. We pair that wisdom with modern nutritional thinking — without inventing miracle chemicals.

settings.label: Modern
settings.title: How modern nutrition supports hair
settings.text: Functional nutrition looks at deficiencies, absorption and consistency. Powdered whole-food blends can offer broader spectrum nutrition than a single synthetic isolate.
